title: Samsung Odyssey OLED G5 G50SF 27 @ $489/314.5 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Centre Com
body:
Deal: Samsung Odyssey OLED G5 G50SF 27 @ $489/314.5 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Centre Com

[djmm] What if it's not a bug? Then I would have 2 monitors
[Edyolo] To be fair, everything increased their price like RAM, SSD, GPU. But monitor seems to be the only things fallen in price…
[coldazure] Only humans need monitors. AI doesn't need em.
[Haunt] Not to mention fewer people can afford to build new rigs nowadays so even less demand for gaming monitors
[Edyolo] Search your Centrecom email for $15 off voucher (expired one still works).
[blewey] how do I find this — got an example? What date did the email land
[panda1010101] this is likely a lower-quality 2nd gen QD-OLED panel, like a binned CPU chip.
Normal QD-OLEDs are 250nits, this is 200nits; 240hz, 180hz; Vesa DisplayHDR400, only HDR10; Full pivot/swivel/tilt, minor tilt
Based on these specs, I'd say you get what you pay for. Otherwise, I'd suggest an Alienware AW2725D
[Edyolo] Completely fair. Pay a little more, you get more. This is more like a get the job done monitor. For my use case with a Mac Mini/Studio, it’s perfect as I don’t need the high refresh rate for gaming.
For gaming I have another set up, so this is a great secondary monitor for me.
[AustriaBargain] It's still probably way better than any TN/IPS monitors we might own though?
[AustriaBargain] Unless you are happy with a full backlit screen or can afford mini LED, then it's worth it still.
[ShowTekk] It's not really, if you have blinds. My qdoled is set at 100 nits for SDR content and it's plenty
[HomeAlone] Seems like a bug.
$350 each delivered previously so I'd hardly consider 2 for $800 + delivery as entering pricing error/bug territory.
